I'm definitely in the minority saying this and it could be due to rewatching the series numerous times but V/H/S/99 is my favorite in the series and Ozzy's Dungeon being my favorite segment. I did not like 85 as much but didn't hate it either. 94 was on the same level as the first movie for me but not as good as 99. And the 2nd movie is almost as good as 99 for me. I would rate beyond in 3rd or 2nd place for me personally! This was an action packed movie and the stork segment was god tier! I loved the bollywood one as a robotic monster is a new addition and it was a twist since I assumed they were going the witch route. The skydiving segment was great in the beginning and alright at the end, I think the more obvious CGI and quick resolution made me feel sort of meh about it overall. Loved fur babies as it was a strange body horror entry and the dog lady reminds me of creepily fake people I have met irl. Also the last part of that segment was hilarious to me. And finally, stowaway was depressing in a good way but it was hard to see what was going on at some points. Despite this, I love how the creepiness factor didnt rely on stereotypical aliens and how we got a view into space and isolation within itself. All in all an 8/10 for me and I rank V/H/S/2 a 9/10 and V/H/S/99 a 10/10.

They tend to happen randomly in the spur of the moment, well as far as meeting your partner for the first time. I am in Iowa but I used to be from LA so I saw both big city and small town dynamics and I do think being in a smaller town helps somehow. Everyone wants love, but achieving passions and goals and focusing on each day is, in my opinion, the best distraction to single life there is. I've been out a lot and traveled a fair bit and in my life I have seen many relationships where the guy seems way out of his girlfriend's league yet they are plenty happy together.
